items.source: The default implementation simply returns null. Note that the default message may be identical to the primary message code (getCodes()), which effectively enforces AbstractMessageSource.setUseCodeAsDefaultMessage(boolean) for this particular message.
items.translation: 默认实现仅返回 null。请注意，默认消息可能与主消息代码（getCodes()）相同，这实际上为特定消息强制实施了AbstractMessageSource.setUseCodeAsDefaultMessage(boolean)。

items.source: Spring's own validation error classes implement this interface.
items.translation: Spring 自身的验证错误类实现了此接口。

items.source:
Return the codes to be used to resolve this message, in the order that
they should get tried. The last code will therefore be the default one.
items.translation: 返回用于解决此消息的代码，按尝试顺序排列。因此，最后一个代码将是默认代码。

items.source: the default message, or null if no default
items.translation: 默认消息，或者如果没有默认值则为null。

items.source: a String array of codes which are associated with this message
items.translation: 与此消息关联的代码的 String 数组

items.source:
an array of objects to be used as parameters to replace
placeholders within the message text
items.translation: 用作替换消息文本中占位符的对象参数数组

items.source: Return the array of arguments to be used to resolve this message.
items.translation: 返回用于解析此消息的参数数组。

items.source:
Return the codes to be used to resolve this message, in the order that
they should get tried.
items.translation: 返回用于解决此消息的代码，按尝试顺序排列。

items.source: Return the default message to be used to resolve this message.
items.translation: 返回用于解析此消息的默认消息。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
